qe: The Golghar, the beehive-shaped grain store of Patna built after the famine of 1770, was constructed in 1786 under the supervision of which engineer?
qh: 1770 के अकाल के बाद बना पटना का मधुमक्खी-छत्ते जैसा अनाज-भंडार गोलघर 1786 में किस इंजीनियर की देखरेख में बनाया गया?
e: Patna ka Golghar 1786 me Captain John Garstin ki nigrani me bana. Ise 1770 ki bhayankar akal ke baad anaj surakshit rakhne ke liye banwaya gaya; iska aakaran gol tatha madhumakkhi ke chhatte jaisa hai, jiski deewarein kaafi moti hain tatha andar charhne ke liye gol ghoomti (spiral) seedhi bani hui hai. Aisa bhandar banane ki soch is baat se nikli ki akal ke samay khane ka anaj na hone par hazaaron logon ki maut hui thi; isliye sarkar ne aage ke liye bada anaj-bhandar khada kiya, taaki vipatti me anaj ka stock rahe. Aaj Golghar Patna ka prasiddh sthal hai tatha isse Ganga tatha poore shahar ka nazara dikhta hai. Robert Barker tatha Hector Munro sainik adhikari the tatha Colonel Forde ne Bedara ki ladai ladi thi. Isliye sahi uttar Captain John Garstin hai. Exam point: Golghar, Patna = 1786, Captain John Garstin dwara anaj-bhandar ke roop me banaya gaya; iski pehchan gol (beehive) aakaran tatha andar ki gol-ghoomti seedhi; yah 1770 ki akal ke baad surakshit anaj-raksha ki soch ka parinaam hai.

qe: Agam Kuan at Patna, a very deep well linked with popular worship, is identified in Buddhist tradition with which feature of Ashoka's reign?
qh: पटना का अगम कुआँ, जो लोक-पूजा से जुड़ा अत्यंत गहरा कुआँ है, बौद्ध परंपरा में अशोक के शासनकाल की किस विशेषता से जोड़ा जाता है?
oe: The 'hell' or torture chamber of Ashoka
Ashoka's hospital for birds and animals
A water tank of the Mauryan army
e: Agam Kuan Patna ka ek bahut gehra kuan ya gadda hai, jise parampara me Ashoka ke us narak ya yatana-grih se joda jaata hai, jiska zikr saatvin sadi ke cheeni yatri Hiuen Tsiang ne kiya tha. Unke varnan me is yatana-grih ka zikr hai: ek Bauddh bhikshu ko us yatana-grih me daala gaya, lekin woh jal nahi paaya tatha kamal ke phool par baitha mila; yah dekh kar raja ka hriday badla tatha woh Bauddh dharm ka anuyayi ban gaya. Isi katha ka ek roop Jain parampara me bhi milta hai, jahan us bhikshu ka naam Sudarsan bataya jaata hai tatha kaha jaata hai ki raja ne use riha kar apne paas basa liya. Aaj bhi log is kuen ko dukh aur narak se joda maante hain, iska paani peete nahi, tatha Asarh ke aathve din hone wale 'Agam Mela' me ek lakh se zyada log phool tatha anya bhent chadhaate hain tatha chechak (smallpox) se bachaav ki prarthana karte hain; isi kshetra me Bulandi Bagh naam ke sthal se mila ek patthar ka slab log Buddha ke us aakhri kadam se jodte hain, jo unhone Ganga paar karne se pehle rakha tha. Isliye sahi uttar Ashoka ke narak ya yatana-grih wala hai. Exam point: Agam Kuan = Ashoka ke 'narak' (torture chamber) se joda jaane wala kuan; Hiuen Tsiang ke varnan me is sthal ka zikr; Asarh ke aathve din Agam Mela me ek lakh se zyada log phool chadhaate hain tatha chechak se bachaav ki prarthana karte hain.

qe: When the Chinese pilgrim Hiuen Tsiang visited Pataliputra around 640 AD, he found the ancient capital in what condition?
qh: जब चीनी यात्री ह्वेनसांग ने 640 ईस्वी के आसपास पाटलिपुत्र का दौरा किया, तब उन्हें प्राचीन राजधानी किस हाल में मिली?
oe: In ruins, with only two or three monasteries still intact
A flourishing city of lakhs of people
Rebuilt as a new Gupta capital
oh: खंडहरों में, जहाँ केवल दो-तीन विहार ही बचे थे
नदी की बाढ़ में दबा हुआ
गुप्तकालीन नई राजधानी के रूप में पुनर्निर्मित
e: 640 AD ke aas-paas jab cheeni yatri Hiuen Tsiang bharat aaye tatha Pataliputra ka daurra kiya, tab unhe yah shahar khandharon me mila. Hiuen Tsiang ne likha ki yah purana shahar lambe samay se ujaad pada tha tatha bachi-khuchi sirf purani neev tatha deewarein thi. Vihar, mandir tatha stupa saikdon ki sankhya me the, lekin unme se keval do ya teen hi poore tatha sahi halat me bache the. Is daur tak Pataliputra ki chamak khatm ho chuki thi, kyunki panchvin-chhatvin sadi ke Huna hamlon tatha Sasanka ke aakraman se shahar ki sthiti bigdi thi tatha Bauddh sansthaon ko bhaari nuksan hua tha. Purane mahal ke uttar me Ganga ke kinare basa bacha-khucha shahar ek chhota kasba tha, jisme lagbhag ek hazaar ghar the; is daur tak Pataliputra ki chamak khatm ho chuki thi, kyunki chhatvin sadi ke Huna hamle ke baad Sasanka ke aakraman se shahar ujad gaya, uske pavitra avshesh nasht hue tatha Bauddh bhikshu bikhar gaye. Aise varnan yatree-sahitya se milte hain, isliye woh prachin Bihar ke itihas ke mahatvapurn pramaan maane jaate hain. Exam point: Hiuen Tsiang ne 640 AD me Pataliputra ko ujaad tatha khandharon me paiya; keval do-teen vihar hi bache the; Huna hamle tatha Sasanka ke aakraman se shahar ki avnati hui.

qe: The large bell of the old church at Patna, known as Padri ki Haveli, was presented in 1782 by Bahadur Sah, who was the son of which ruler?
qh: पटना के पुराने गिरजाघर, जिसे 'पादरी की हवेली' कहा जाता है, की बड़ी घंटी 1782 में बहादुर साह ने भेंट की थी, जो किस शासक के पुत्र थे?
e: Patna ke purane girjaghar ko log Padri ki Haveli kehte hain. Is imarat ki banawat ka shrey ek jaane-maane architect Tiretto ko diya jaata hai, jinhone ise 1772 me design kiya. Isi girjaghar ki badi ghanti 1782 me Bahadur Sah ne bhej kar bhent ki thi; woh Nepal ke Raja Prithvi Narain ke putra the. Nepal ke ek rajkumar dwara Patna ke girjaghar ko ghanti bhent karna dikhata hai ki us daur me Patna tatha Nepal ke seemant kshetra ke beech dharmik tatha vyaparik sambandh kitne ghanishth the. Padri ki Haveli Patna ka sabse purana girjaghar maana jaata hai, jo aaj bhi Patna City kshetra me sthit hai tatha dekhne layak dharohar hai. Awadh ke Nawab, Tirhut ke Raja tatha Darbhanga ke Maharaja ka is ghanti se seedha sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: Padri ki Haveli (Patna) ki imarat ka design 1772 me architect Tiretto ne banaya; iski badi ghanti 1782 me Nepal ke Raja Prithvi Narain ke putra Bahadur Sah ne bhent ki; yah Patna ka sabse purana girjaghar maana jaata hai.

qe: The mosque at Patna built in 1499 by Allauddin Husain Shah, Sultan of Gaur, and later repaired by Begu Hajjam in 1654, is famous for what feature?
qh: 1499 में गौड़ के सुल्तान अलाउद्दीन हुसैन शाह द्वारा बनवाई तथा 1654 में बेगू हज्जाम द्वारा मरम्मत कराई गई पटना की मस्जिद किस विशेषता के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
oe: A marble minaret taller than the Qutub Minar
A courtyard paved with glazed tiles of Gaur
oh: कुतुब मीनार से ऊँची संगमरमर की मीनार
गौड़ की चमकीली टाइलों से बना प्रांगण
e: Patna ki yah masjid Gaur ke Sultan Allauddin Husain Shah ne 1499 me banwai thi tatha lagbhag dedh sau saal baad 1654 me Begu Hajjam ne iski marammat karai. Is masjid ka sabse khaas hissa iska prangan hai, jise Gaur ki chamkili tatha rangeen tile-kaari wale pattharon se banaya gaya hai. Aise tile tatha patthar ka kaam us daur ki pehchan hai, jab Gaur ke sultanat ka prabhav Bihar ke ek bade hisse tak phaila hua tha. Yah masjid ab dekh-rekh ki kami ke karan kharab halat me hai, isliye ise puratatv tatha dharohar ki drishti se mahatvapurn maana jaata hai. Ek hi lakdi ka gumbad, kutub minar se unchi sangmarmar minar tatha bhoomigat namaz-kaksh is masjid ki visheshataen nahi hain. Exam point: 1499 ki yah masjid Gaur ke Sultan Allauddin Husain Shah ne banwai tatha 1654 me Begu Hajjam ne marammat karai; iski pehchan Gaur-style glazed tiles ka prangan tatha tarashe patthar ka darwaza hai.

qe: Sher Shah's mosque at Patna, built between 1540 and 1545 near the eastern gate of the old city, has how many domes in all?
qh: पुराने शहर के पूरबी दरवाज़े के पास 1540 से 1545 के बीच बनी शेरशाह की मस्जिद पर कुल कितने गुंबद हैं?
oe: Three domes in a single row
Five - one large in the centre and four small at the corners
oh: पाँच - बीच में एक बड़ा तथा कोनों पर चार छोटे
e: Sher Shah Suri ne 1540 se 1545 ke beech Patna City ke purabi darwaze ke paas ek masjid banwai, jise Sher Shah ki masjid kaha jaata hai. Yah ent (brick) se bani hui hai; iski banawat dekhne me saadi magar mazboot hai, jiske beech me ek bada gumbad tatha chaaron konon par ek-ek chhota gumbad hai, is tarah kul paanch gumbad dikhte hain. Masjid ke bahar kai kabrein bhi hain, jinme sabse purani kabar Ashraf Ali Khan ki hai, jo Mughal badshah Muhammad Shah ke doodh-bhai (foster brother) the. Sher Shah ne poore desh me sadak tatha sarai ki vyavastha se yatra-vyapar ko aasan kiya tha, isliye unke kaal ki imaratein saadi tatha majboot hone ke bawajood apni pehchan banati hain. Isliye sahi uttar paanch gumbad hai. Exam point: Sher Shah ki masjid = Patna City ke purabi darwaze ke paas, 1540-1545 ke beech bani, paanch gumbad (ek bada beech me tatha chaar chhote konon par), ent ki mazboot banawat; bahar sabse purani kabar Ashraf Ali Khan ki.

qe: Pathar ki Masjid of Patna, standing on the bank of the Ganga, was built in 1621 by which prince who served as governor of Bihar?
qh: गंगा के तट पर स्थित पटना की 'पत्थर की मस्जिद' 1621 में बिहार के गवर्नर रहे किस शहज़ादे ने बनवाई थी?
oe: Dara Shikoh, son of Shah Jahan
Murad Baksh, son of Shah Jahan
e: Patna ki Pathar ki Masjid Ganga kinare par sthit ek purani tatha bhavya masjid hai. Ise 1621 me Shahzade Parvez Shah ne banwaya tha, jo Mughal badshah Jahangir ke putra the tatha apne pita ke samay Bihar ke gavarnar ke roop me yahan rehte the. Naam se hi saaf hai ki is masjid me patthar ka bada upyog hua hai; iski saadgi tatha mazbooti ise Patna ke mahatvapurn Mughal-kaaleen sthalon me shamil karti hai. Mughal shahzade jab kisi sube ke gavarnar hote the, tab woh wahan masjid, bagh tatha imaratein banwate the, jisse shahar ki shobha badhti thi tatha unki apni pehchan banti thi. Azim-us-Shan ke naam par Patna ka purana naam Azimabad pada tha, lekin Pathar ki Masjid ka nirman Parvez Shah se juda hai; Dara Shikoh tatha Murad Baksh is sthal ke nirmata nahi hai. Exam point: Pathar ki Masjid (Patna) = 1621, Jahangir ke putra Parvez Shah dwara banwai gayi; woh us samay Bihar ke gavarnar the; Patna ka purana naam Azimabad Azim-us-Shan se juda hai, masjid ke nirman se nahi.

qe: Patna's fort on the Ganga, which gave the city strategic importance in the 16th century, was built in 1541 by which ruler?
qh: गंगा के किनारे पटना का किला, जिसने 16वीं सदी में शहर को सामरिक महत्व दिया, 1541 में किस शासक ने बनवाया?
e: Patna me Ganga ke kinare kila 1541 me Sher Shah Suri ne banwaya; isi ke baad shahar tezi se mahatvapurn ban gaya. Sher Shah ke kila banane ke lagbhag 45 saal baad, 1586 me, angrej vyapari Ralph Fitch ne Patna ko ek bade shahar ke roop me dekha, jahan afim (opium) tatha suti kapde (cotton cloth) ka bada vyapar hota tha; shahar purab se pashchim tak lagbhag dedh mile tatha uttar se dakshin tak teen-chauthai mile tak phaila hua tha. Sher Shah ne sadak tatha sarai ki vyavastha se yatra-vyapar aasan kiya tha, isliye Ganga-kinare shahron jaise Patna ka vyapar bhi badha. Aage 18vein sadi ke shuru me shahar ki purani deewar ke bahar bhi basti phaili tatha suraksha ke liye khai tatha deewar ki marammat karani padi. Babur, Allauddin Husain Shah tatha Islam Shah is kila-nirman ke liye jaane nahi jaate. Exam point: Patna ka kila = 1541, Sher Shah Suri dwara; 1586 me Ralph Fitch ne Patna ko afim tatha suti kapde ke bade vyapar wala shahar bataya; Sher Shah ki sadak-sarai vyavastha ne yatra tatha vyapar badhaya.

qe: Shaista Khan's mosque and Katra, and the Ambar Mosque built by his nazim Khwaja Ambar, stand in which old part of Patna?
qh: शाइस्ता खान की मस्जिद तथा कटरा, और उनके नाज़िम ख्वाजा अंबर द्वारा बनवाई अंबर मस्जिद, पटना के किस पुराने हिस्से में स्थित हैं?
oe: The Chauk, the main city street
e: Purane Patna ke Chauk kshetra me Shaista Khan ki masjid tatha katra bani hui hai. Shaista Khan Bangal ke subedar the tatha yah masjid unke samay, 17vein sadi ke ant me, banwayi gayi maani jaati hai. Unke nazim Khwaja Ambar ne 1688-89 me Ambar Masjid banwai, isliye yah bhi Chauk kshetra ki pehchan hai. Isi ilaake me Allauddin Husain Shah ki 1499 ki masjid tatha uske paas Makhd-ud-daula ki masjid bhi sthit hai, jo 1731 se 1736 ke beech Patna ke gavarnar rahe. Katra ka arth hota hai ek aisi bazar-basti, jo bade dharmik ya vyaparik sansthan ke saath basai jaati thi; isliye masjid ke saath katra banwana us daur ki vyaparik soch dikhata hai, jab dharmik sthal ke aas-paas bazar tatha karkhane bhi base. Bankipore maidan, Digha tatha Kumrahar alag kshetra hain. Exam point: Shaista Khan ki masjid tatha katra, Khwaja Ambar ki Ambar Masjid (1688-89), Allauddin Husain Shah ki 1499 ki masjid tatha Makhd-ud-daula ki masjid - sab Chauk kshetra, Patna me sthit hain; katra = dharmik sthal ke saath basai gayi bazar-basti.
